title: Conley: Trump 'Does Not Have Many Options' on Iran
title_cn: 康利：特朗普在伊朗问题上“没有太多选择”
summary: Heather Conley, Senior Fellow at the American Enterprise Institute and Former Deputy Assistant Secretary of State, says dwindling targets and munitions are limiting President Donald Trump's options on Iran as hardliners in Tehran toughen their position. Conley says "nothing has shifted on the ground" in the Strait of Hormuz, with little traffic getting through, and argues Iran continues to view the waterway as a key source of leverage. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Markets Open the Week Flat as Oil Prices Rise | The Close 8/10/2026
title_cn: 随着油价上涨，市场本周开盘持平收盘价 2026 年 8 月 10 日
summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Rithholtz Wealth Management Chief Market Strategist Callie Cox, Needham Senior Analyst Ryan MacDonald, Former Kansas City Fed President & CEO Thomas Hoenig, Kayne Anderson Rudnick Portfolio Manager, Senior Research Analyst Julie Biel, Founder ETFs Partner and Portfolio Manager Michael Monaghan, Evercore ISI International Political Affairs & Public Policy Chief Strategist Sarah Bianchi, Gotham Greens CEO Craig Stevenson, & Former NFL Linebacker Bart Scott. title: Jones Act Relief Extended, Iran War Presses On | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 8/10/2026
title_cn: 琼斯法案救济延长，伊朗战争继续进行彭博商业周刊日报 8/10/2026
summary: President Trump extended a waiver Monday for foreign ships transporting oil around the US as the war in Iran continues to disrupt supply chains. Bloomberg News' Mike McKee & Bloomberg Economics' Chris Kennedy explain the implications. Then, Grindr CEO George Arison discusses how the app is transforming to an AI-native platform. Plus, US Antimony Chairman & CEO Gery Evans discusses his company's work with the Trump Administration as it works to boost the US weapons stockpile and supply of critical minerals. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Burnham Touts Plans to Crack Down on UK Vaping, Betting Shops
title_cn: 伯纳姆鼓吹计划打击英国电子烟和博彩商店
summary: Andy Burnham is detailing plans to crack down on the number of new vaping and betting shops, his latest announcement focused on tackling everyday issues as he tries to win over voters since becoming Britain’s prime minister.
